items.title: PostgreSQL 14 EOL: CONFIRMED, date unchanged at 2026-11-12 (22 days out).
The versioning page and the postgresql.org front-page banner both say PG14 "will stop receiving fixes on November 12, 2026".
The roadmap schedules the Nov 12 minor release on the same day, which is PG14's last.
pgvector's unreleased 0.9.0 also drops PG13 and PG14.
No scheduled minor release in the window.
PostgreSQL 19 moved: RC1 shipped 2026-10-15 (Beta 4 was the prior stage).
RC2 is planned for 2026-11-12 alongside the minors, and GA for 2026-11-19. The roadmap page still says "October 2026", so it is stale.
Post-beta fixes touch REPACK (CONCURRENTLY), pg_plan_advice, planner NULL-ability optimizations, auto-enabled logical replication when wal_level=replica, and parallel autovacuum.
One behavior change: COPY (query) TO … (FORMAT json) now uses the query's column aliases as JSON keys, not the base table's column names.
Aurora PostgreSQL batch: CONFIRMED.

pgvector CVE-2026-103484 (GHSA-pw7q-9788-x566): IVFFlat index-build buffer overflow, fixed in 0.8.7 (2026-10-01).
Affects 0.8.6 and below. A database user who can create an IVFFlat index can write out of bounds, which can lead to code execution. No CVSS is stated in the issue.
It is not in CISA KEV (I checked the feed, dated 2026-10-20), and there is no reported exploitation.
Earlier 0.8.x releases fixed HNSW vacuum index corruption (0.8.3), an HNSW build overflow (0.8.2) and 32-bit IVFFlat overflows (0.8.6).

MongoDB 9.0.0 is GA (2026-09-28 per the release notes; the press release is dated 29 Sep). 9.0.4 followed on 2026-10-13. The 9.0 release notes list these changes:
Per-operation memory is now capped at 1 GB or 20% of RAM, whichever is greater.
maxConcurrentMultiDocumentTransactions now defaults to 10000.
BSON validation is always on, and net.wireObjectCheck is deprecated.
$queryStats samples 1% by default.
Time-series collections are now a single namespace and can be renamed.
Server-side JavaScript ($function, $where, $accumulator) is no longer deprecated and runs on a WebAssembly-based engine.
Queryable Encryption prefix, suffix and substring queries are GA.
mongocryptd is deprecated in favor of the Automatic Encryption Shared Library.
Several metrics are renamed, which can break monitoring dashboards.
9.0.0 through 9.0.2 had a step-up hang (SERVER-133518), fixed in 9.0.4. Avoid those three patches.

SERVER-136226 (open): if ShardingTaskExecutorPoolMinSize is above 1, set ShardingTaskExecutorPoolMinSizeForConfigServers to 1 before upgrading sharded clusters.
SERVER-136961 (open): a node doing file-copy initial sync after an unclean shutdown can crash repeatedly.
SERVER-89953 (open): at FCV 9.0, listIndexes reports collation: {locale: "simple"}, so Mongoose, Doctrine ODM and Beanie syncIndexes() may drop and rebuild unchanged indexes.
More than 5,000 time-series collections in one database can cause slow updates and write-latency spikes.
8.0.34 changes the default of skipAuthenticationToSearchIndexManagementServer to false.
Vendor-run performance numbers (not independent): MongoDB claims 9.0 is up to 35% faster for find-one, up to 30% faster for update-one, and up to 2x throughput on large instances versus 8.0.
